name: siyuan
description: Search and read notes from a local SiYuan workspace you authorize.

interface.longDescription: Search notes in the SiYuan workspace you authorize on this computer. Read matching notes and cite their original SiYuan links. Access is read-only and can be revoked in SiYuan. Note excerpts used in a conversation are shared with OpenAI as conversation context.
defaultPrompt: Find my SiYuan notes about the launch checklist.
Summarize the meeting notes and cite the original notes.

positive.description: Search across notebooks in the authorized workspace
positive.prompt: Find my SiYuan notes that mention the cobalt launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Launch Checklist and Meeting Notes from two notebooks in the authorized workspace, each with a SiYuan source link.

positive.description: Read a note found by search
positive.prompt: Find the cobalt launch checklist, then tell me its rollout date and cite the note.
positive.expected_behavior: Report 12 February 2027 and cite the Launch Checklist link.

positive.description: Read by an exact SiYuan note ID
positive.prompt: Read my SiYuan note 20270115100000-meet001 and tell me who owns the smoke test.
positive.expected_behavior: Report that Lin owns the smoke test and cite the Meeting Notes link.

positive.prompt: Read my SiYuan note 20270115100000-long001 and tell me whether you saw the whole note.
positive.expected_behavior: Say that only an excerpt was returned. Cite the note and do not claim to have seen the rest.

positive.prompt: Find my SiYuan notes about the nonexistent amber satellite.
positive.expected_behavior: Report that no accessible notes match, without fabricating a source.

negative.description: Reject a note from an unauthorized workspace
negative.prompt: Read SiYuan note 20270115100000-priv001 from my other workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Return a generic unavailable message. Do not disclose the title, contents or whether the note exists.

negative.prompt: After revoking the plugin connection in SiYuan, search my notes for cobalt launch.
negative.expected_behavior: Return a message that access needs to be reconnected. No note data are returned.

negative.prompt: Use the SiYuan plugin to delete the cobalt launch checklist.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin does not provide deletion. No notes are changed.

publication.release_notes: Initial desktop integration for searching and reading authorized SiYuan notes.
